Film & TV Tool

PropOS

PropOS makes the phones and screens actors hold on set do exactly what the scene needs, on cue, take after take. A prop device joins with a short code and shows a believable phone: lock screen with a scripted clock, incoming calls, live texts with typing, hacker terminals. The crew fires each beat from a web control room and sees every device mirrored live, exactly as the camera does. In development.

Features

  • Phone shell, calls, messaging and terminal templates
  • Devices pair with a 6-character code, no accounts
  • GO cue list, blackout and remote brightness
  • Truthful live mirror of every prop device
  • Scripted status bar: clock, battery, carrier
  • Event log of every cue and actor tap

Technologies

Flutter Next.js Firebase Realtime Database Firestore Android iOS Web
